observations: Two retail boxes for Sony PlayStation 5 consoles are stacked vertically.
The box graphics show the 'Slim' model design, characterized by the horizontal slit in the white faceplates.
The text 'SONY' and 'PS5' is clearly visible on the packaging.
A watermark 'NORX GLOBAL TECHNOLOGIES' is overlaid on the image.
The boxes are sealed or closed; the actual consoles, controllers, and cables are not visible.
Only two units are visible in the photo, contradicting the claim of ten units.

risks.proof: A photo of the boxes open showing the consoles and controllers inside.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock or stolen image (indicated by the watermark).
risks.proof: A photo of the items with a handwritten note showing the seller's name and today's date.

proof_requests: Photo of all 10 units together to verify quantity.
Photo of the consoles outside of the boxes.
Photo of the model number and serial number on the bottom of the boxes.

response.reason: Only the exterior of two boxes is shown for a high-value item. Without seeing the actual consoles and verifying the quantity and ownership, a safe valuation is not possible.
